cultural_controls: Strict adherence to sowing window (June 15 - July 15); avoid long duration varieties; terminate crop by December to prevent off-season host carryover; deep summer ploughing.
mechanical_physical_controls: Install delta/funnel pheromone traps @ 4-5 traps/acre for monitoring; 8-10 traps/acre for mass trapping; manual plucking and destroying of rosette flowers.
biological_controls: Release Trichogramma bactrae egg parasitoid @ 60,000 eggs/acre (3 tricho-cards) at 45 and 60 DAS; spray Neem oil 1500 ppm @ 1 liter/acre (5 ml/L) at early square stage.
monitoring_etl: 8 moths/trap/night for 3 consecutive nights OR 10% rosette flowers.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Proclaim 5% SG (Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG) @ 88 g/acre (6.6 g per 15L pump) or Delegate 11.7% SC (Spinetoram) @ 170 ml/acre (13 ml per 15L pump).
niphm_citation: NIPHM Hyderabad & ICAR-CICR Cotton IPM Strategy 2025

cultural_controls: Adopt 'alley formation' (skipping 1 row after every 8-10 rows) for aeration and sunlight; alternate wetting and drying (AWD) water management; avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer.
mechanical_physical_controls: Drain water completely for 3-4 days when initial hopper colonies are observed; install light traps to monitor hopper flights.
biological_controls: Conserve predatory wolf spiders (Lycosa pseudoannulata) and mirid bugs (Cyrtorhinus lividipennis); avoid broad-spectrum pyrethroid sprays which cause BPH resurgence.
monitoring_etl: 5-10 insects per hill at tillering; 15-20 insects per hill at panicle initiation.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Chess 50% WG (Pymetrozine 50% WG) @ 120 g/acre (9 g per 15L pump) or Token/Osheen 20% SG (Dinotefuran) @ 80-100 g/acre (6-7.5 g per 15L pump) directed at plant base.

cultural_controls: Clip seedling leaf tips before transplanting to eliminate egg masses; synchronise planting; harvest crop close to ground level to eliminate overwintering larvae.
mechanical_physical_controls: Install Scirpo-lure pheromone traps @ 4-5 traps/acre; collect and destroy egg masses during field inspection.
biological_controls: Release Trichogramma japonicum @ 40,000 eggs/acre (2 cards) twice at weekly intervals starting 30 DAT.
monitoring_etl: 1 egg mass/sq.m or 5% dead hearts at vegetative stage; 2% white ears at flowering.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Coragen 18.5% SC (Chlorantraniliprole) @ 60 ml/acre (4.5 ml per 15L pump) or Caldan 50% SP (Cartap Hydrochloride) @ 400 g/acre (30 g per 15L pump).

cultural_controls: Grow 3-4 border rows of maize, sorghum or bajra as barrier crop; intercrop with coriander; maintain field sanitation free from solanaceous weeds.
mechanical_physical_controls: Erect blue sticky traps @ 15-20 traps/acre for thrips and yellow sticky traps for whiteflies at crop canopy height.
biological_controls: Spray Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE 5%) or Azadirachtin 10000 ppm @ 1.5 ml/L; release predatory mites Amblyseius swirskii @ 10 mites/sq.m.
monitoring_etl: 1-2 thrips per leaf or upward curling on 10% seedlings.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Pegasus 50% WP (Diafenthiuron 50% WP) @ 240 g/acre (18 g per 15L pump) for thrips; Oberon 22.9% SC (Spiromesifen) @ 200 ml/acre (15 ml per 15L pump) for mites.

cultural_controls: Use certified disease-free seeds; avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; collect and burn fallen infected fruits.
mechanical_physical_controls: Raise plants on raised beds covered with silver-on-black polyethylene mulch to prevent soil splashing.
biological_controls: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 4 g/kg seed + Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/kg seed; foliar spray of Trichoderma harzianum @ 5 g/L.
monitoring_etl: First appearance of circular sunken spots on developing or ripening fruits.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Folicur 25.9% EC (Tebuconazole) @ 250 ml/acre (18 ml per 15L pump) or Amistar Top (Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole) @ 200 ml/acre (15 ml per 15L pump).

cultural_controls: Plant African tall marigold (Tagetes erecta) as trap crop (1 row of marigold for every 16 rows of tomato).
mechanical_physical_controls: Install Helilure pheromone traps @ 5 traps/acre; hand-pick and destroy initial bored fruits with caterpillars.
biological_controls: Release Trichogramma pretiosum @ 50,000 eggs/acre; spray HaNPV @ 250 LE/acre (1.5 ml/L) with 0.1% jaggery sticker in evening hours.
monitoring_etl: 1 larva per plant or 5% fruit damage.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Fame 39.35% SC (Flubendiamide) @ 60 ml/acre (4.5 ml per 15L pump) or Coragen 18.5% SC @ 60 ml/acre (4.5 ml per 15L pump).

cultural_controls: Use pest-free seedlings raised under 40-mesh nylon insect net nurseries; destroy crop residues immediately after final harvest.
mechanical_physical_controls: Install Tuta pheromone water traps or delta traps @ 12-15 traps/acre; seal greenhouse vents with insect-proof netting.
biological_controls: Release mirid predator Nesidiocoris tenuis; foliar spray of Bacillus thuringiensis kurstaki (Btk) @ 2 g/L.
monitoring_etl: 20-30 moths/trap/week or 1 active mine per leaf.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Delegate 11.7% SC (Spinetoram) @ 180 ml/acre (13.5 ml per 15L pump) or Coragen 18.5% SC @ 60 ml/acre (4.5 ml per 15L pump).

cultural_controls: Synchronised community planting within 2-week window; intercrop with cowpea or pigeonpea; avoid staggered sowing.
mechanical_physical_controls: Hand-picking and crushing of egg masses and young larvae; apply dry fine sand or wood ash into whorls of attacked plants to damage larval cuticle.
biological_controls: Erect T-shaped bird perches @ 15-20 per acre; spray Beauveria bassiana 1x10^8 CFU/g @ 1 kg/acre (5 g/L) or Metarhizium rileyi at early whorl stage.
monitoring_etl: 5% damaged plants with larvae at seedling/early whorl stage.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Coragen 18.5% SC (Chlorantraniliprole) @ 80 ml/acre (6 ml per 15L pump) or Delegate 11.7% SC @ 170 ml/acre directed into leaf whorls.

cultural_controls: Grow border rows of sorghum/bajra (3 rows) as barrier; avoid excessive chemical urea application which triggers vegetative succulence.
mechanical_physical_controls: Install yellow sticky traps (for whiteflies/jassids) and blue sticky traps (for thrips) @ 15-20 traps/acre.
biological_controls: Release green lacewing Chrysoperla zastrowi @ 4,000 larvae/acre; foliar spray of Verticillium lecanii @ 1 kg/acre.
monitoring_etl: 6-8 whiteflies/leaf; 2 jassids/leaf; 5 thrips/leaf.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Token/Osheen 20% SG (Dinotefuran) @ 60-80 g/acre (4.5-6 g per 15L pump) or Actara 25% WG (Thiamethoxam) @ 40 g/acre (3 g per 15L pump).

cultural_controls: Use resistant / tolerant varieties (RNR 15048, MTU 1010, BPT 5204 with seed treatment); avoid over-application of nitrogen; apply nitrogen in 3 split doses.
mechanical_physical_controls: Maintain thin film of water; avoid drought stress as dry soil condition drastically escalates blast susceptibility.
biological_controls: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/kg seed + foliar spray @ 5 g/L at maximum tillering.
monitoring_etl: 1-2 spindle-shaped lesions per hill on leaves or initial neck infection signs.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Amistar Top (Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC) @ 200 ml/acre (15 ml per 15L pump) or Nativo 75% WG (Trifloxystrobin + Tebuconazole) @ 80 g/acre (6 g per 15L pump).

cultural_controls: Crop rotation with non-legumes (sorghum, pearl millet, maize); clean cultivation by destroying crop residues.
mechanical_physical_controls: Maintain optimal plant population; ensure adequate drainage to avoid collar water stagnation.
biological_controls: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 4 g/kg seed; application of 1 kg Trichoderma enriched in 100 kg FYM per acre into soil at sowing.
monitoring_etl: Initial leaf lesions observed at 40-45 DAS.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Custodia / Harpul (Tebuconazole 10% + Sulphur 65% WG) @ 500 g/acre (37.5 g per 15L pump) or Saaf (Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP) @ 300 g/acre (22 g per 15L pump).

cultural_controls: Plant recommended varieties; maintain plant spacing of 45x5 cm; deep summer ploughing to expose pupae to predatory birds.
mechanical_physical_controls: Hand-pick and destroy girdled shoots containing eggs and young larvae at early stage.
biological_controls: Erect T-shaped bird perches @ 15-20 per acre; spray Bacillus thuringiensis var. kurstaki @ 400 g/acre (3 g/L).
monitoring_etl: 5% plants showing girdled rings or 3-4 semilooper larvae per meter row.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Coragen 18.5% SC (Chlorantraniliprole) @ 60 ml/acre (4.5 ml per 15L pump) or Ampligo (Chlorantraniliprole 9.3% + Lambda-cyhalothrin 4.6% ZC) @ 80 ml/acre.

cultural_controls: Intercrop with sorghum, maize or green gram; plant trap crops (marigold); maintain wider row spacing (120-150 cm).
mechanical_physical_controls: Install Helilure pheromone traps @ 5 traps/acre; shake plants early in morning over cloth sheets to dislodge and collect larvae.
biological_controls: Release Trichogramma chilonis @ 40,000 eggs/acre at flower bud stage; spray HaNPV @ 200 LE/acre + 0.5 kg jaggery in evening.
monitoring_etl: 1 larva per plant or 5% pod damage.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Coragen 18.5% SC @ 60 ml/acre (4.5 ml per 15L pump) or Fame 39.35% SC (Flubendiamide) @ 40 ml/acre (3 ml per 15L pump) at 50% flowering.

cultural_controls: Intercrop with coriander, mustard or linseed (4:1 row ratio); early sowing in October to escape heavy terminal pod borer attack.
mechanical_physical_controls: Erect bird perches @ 20 T-perches/acre; install Helilure pheromone traps @ 4-5 traps/acre.
biological_controls: Spray HaNPV @ 200 LE/acre (1.5 ml/L) or Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE 5%) at pod initiation stage.
monitoring_etl: 1 larva per meter row or 5-10% pod damage.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Proclaim 5% SG (Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG) @ 80-88 g/acre (6-6.6 g per 15L pump) or Coragen 18.5% SC @ 50 ml/acre.

cultural_controls: Sow timely before October 25 to enable crop to pass vulnerable flowering stage before peak aphid immigration in January.
mechanical_physical_controls: Install yellow sticky traps @ 15-20 traps/acre; pluck and destroy initial aphid-infested floral twigs.
biological_controls: Conserve predatory Coccinellid beetles (Coccinella septempunctata) and syrphid fly maggots; spray Verticillium lecanii @ 1 kg/acre.
monitoring_etl: 20% plants infested or 1.5 cm aphid colony on central shoot.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Actara 25% WG (Thiamethoxam 25% WG) @ 40-50 g/acre (3.5 g per 15L pump) or Rogor 30% EC (Dimethoate) @ 250-300 ml/acre (20 ml per 15L pump).

cultural_controls: Plant setts in deep trenches; apply light frequent irrigations during hot summer months; earthing-up at 45 and 90 DAP.
mechanical_physical_controls: Trash mulching (10 cm thick dry sugarcane trash) across rows at 3 DAP to conserve soil moisture and prevent borer oviposition.
biological_controls: Release Trichogramma chilonis egg parasitoid @ 50,000/ha (2.5 cards) weekly 4-6 times from 30 DAP.
monitoring_etl: 15% dead hearts during formative stage.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Coragen 18.5% SC (Chlorantraniliprole) @ 150 ml/acre applied as directed soil drench along cane row at 30-45 DAP.

cultural_controls: Grow two rows of maize or outer barrier of barrier crops; avoid water stress during bulb enlargement; crop rotation with non-allium crops.
mechanical_physical_controls: Install blue and yellow sticky traps @ 20 traps/acre; overhead sprinkler irrigation reduces thrips population by mechanical dislodging.
biological_controls: Spray Beauveria bassiana 1x10^8 CFU/g @ 1 kg/acre (5 g/L) with sticker; Trichoderma viride seed and seedling dip.
monitoring_etl: 30 thrips per plant or initial purple spots on foliage.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Pegasus 50% WP (Diafenthiuron) @ 240 g/acre (18 g per 15L pump) + Custodia (Tebuconazole + Azoxystrobin) @ 300 ml/acre (22 ml per 15L pump).

cultural_controls: Use certified disease-free seed tubers from trusted seed source (CPRI); destroy cull piles and volunteer potato plants.
mechanical_physical_controls: High earthing-up to ensure 10-15 cm soil cover over tubers preventing spore wash-down from foliage to tubers.
biological_controls: Prophylactic spray of Trichoderma harzianum @ 5 g/L before onset of cloudy fog weather.
monitoring_etl: First appearance of water-soaked blighted lesions on leaf margins in locality.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Preventive: Dithane M-45 (Mancozeb 75% WP) @ 600-800 g/acre (50 g per 15L pump); Curative: Ridomil Gold (Metalaxyl-M 4% + Mancozeb 64% WP) @ 500 g/acre (37.5 g per 15L pump).

cultural_controls: Select disease-free seed rhizomes; provide excellent field drainage; plant on raised broad beds (120 cm width); incorporate neem cake @ 200 kg/acre.
mechanical_physical_controls: Apply green leaf mulch (5 tonnes/acre) at planting and repeat at 45 and 90 DAP to conserve moisture and suppress pathogens.
biological_controls: Rhizome treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/kg rhizome for 30 min before planting; soil application of 2 kg Trichoderma in 200 kg FYM/acre.
monitoring_etl: First collar water-soaking or leaf yellowing symptoms.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Drench collar region with Ridomil Gold (Metalaxyl 4% + Mancozeb 64% WP) @ 2.5 g/L or Copper Oxychloride 50% WP (Blitox) @ 3 g/L.

cultural_controls: Grow resistant varieties (HD-3086, DBW-187, DBW-222, PBW-725); avoid early sowing of susceptible varieties in foothills of Himalayas.
mechanical_physical_controls: Participatory surveillance and stripe rust scouting from December to February.
biological_controls: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 4 g/kg seed to boost systemic plant vigor.
monitoring_etl: First isolated yellow stripe pustule colony detected in field.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Tilt 25% EC (Propiconazole 25% EC) @ 200 ml/acre (15 ml per 15L pump) in 200 liters water immediately upon detection.

target_pest_disease: Yellow Mosaic Virus & Maruca Pod Borer
cultural_controls: Use YMV resistant varieties (PU 31, VBN 8, WBG 26); destroy alternate weed hosts like Croton bonplandianum.
mechanical_physical_controls: Erect yellow sticky traps @ 15-20 traps/acre to trap whitefly vectors early.
biological_controls: Seed treatment with Imidacloprid 600 FS (5 ml/kg seed) followed by foliar spray of Neem oil 1500 ppm @ 2 ml/L.
monitoring_etl: 5 whiteflies per leaf or 5% webbed flowers/pods.
chemical_last_resort_cibrc: Coragen 18.5% SC @ 50 ml/acre (3.5 ml per 15L pump) for Maruca; Actara 25% WG @ 40 g/acre for whitefly vector.
